archetype: THE PERFORMANCE PRO / SWISS HIGH-CONTRAST TECH
theme: hybrid (Dark obsidian dashboard mode + crisp high-trust public checkout mode with light/dark toggle)
emotional_tone: Institutional trust, Web3 native precision, sub-cent gas efficiency, real-time auditability

headings.family: Plus Jakarta Sans, Space Grotesk, sans-serif

mono.family: JetBrains Mono, Source Code Pro, monospace
mono.usage: Tx hashes, nonces, Base wallet addresses, gas fees, USDC amounts, ERP webhook payload logs

layout_and_spacing.dashboard_grid: MODE B: High Density Grid (4-col desktop, 2-col tablet, 1-col mobile)
layout_and_spacing.checkout_page: Centering with asymmetric summary panel, high contrast action card, explicit state steps
layout_and_spacing.container_padding: Internal padding p-6 or p-8 to prevent text collisions with borders
layout_and_spacing.grid_gap: gap-4 to gap-6 for dashboards; gap-8 for public checkout engine

core_modules.name: The Public Checkout Engine
key_elements: Base Wallet Connector button (Mocked/Connected status badge with address ellipsis 0x...8F2a)
USDC Invoice summary card (Item name, Subtotal, Base gas fee estimated <$0.01, Total in USDC)
One-click Pay USDC button with dynamic status transitions (Connecting -> Tx Broadcasting -> Base Confirmation -> Reconciled Toast)
Instant transaction link to BaseScan Explorer (mock link with actual tx hash)

core_modules.name: The Onchain Listener & Verification Center
core_modules.route: Integrated background simulation & Real-time Live Feed in Founder Dashboard
key_elements: Live WebSocket/polling event pulse (USDC contract transfer events on Base Mainnet/Sepolia)
Automatic invoice nonce matching indicator with latency badge (e.g., 420ms reconciliation speed)

core_modules.name: The ERP Sync Webhook Engine (QuickBooks / Xero)
key_elements: ERP Provider status toggle (QuickBooks Online vs Xero vs Custom Webhook)
Live Sync Status logs table (Invoice ID, Onchain Tx, ERP Journal Entry ID, Sync Timestamp, Retry button)
Payload inspector drawer/modal for developer founders to inspect raw Web2 accounting JSON

core_modules.name: The Founder SaaS Command Center
key_elements: Hero MRR & ARR stat cards with percentage growth sparklines
Active Subscriptions overview card with Base USDC recurring stream indicators
Payment History data table with sorting, filtering by payment status (PENDING/PAID/FAILED), search by Tx/Customer
Quick link generator modal to craft shareable USDC checkout URLs with custom amount, customer email, and ERP product ID

component_guidelines.shadcn_usage: Use customized Shadcn UI for Dialog, DropdownMenu, Tabs, Select, Switch, Table, Sheet, Sonner toast, Badge, Card
component_guidelines.card_borders: 1px solid border-border with subtle hover transform (-translate-y-0.5) and glow border focus
component_guidelines.data_tables: Sticky header, pagination controls, clear copy-to-clipboard for Base hashes, status badge pill components
component_guidelines.toast_notifications: Use Sonner for payment state changes, wallet connections, invoice link copying, and ERP sync triggers

image_urls.description: Founders reviewing financial metrics on MacBook

testing_requirements.data_testid_convention: kebab-case, role-based naming for all interactive controls and status data fields

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, on distribution outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the AI slop aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) on floating navbars or sticky header toolbars.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g. transition: all). Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 for icons. Use lucide-react icons exclusively.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
